notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.45 — Already Hired now asks two clear confirmations with a final ARE YOU SURE? prompt. Once confirmed, it updates official MBL to Hired and verifies the official result before moving the driver to Finished. Archive/Restore remains Hub-only; checklists remain local to each PC/laptop.
